answer: Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 137 identities means 137 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Because the island pair is tracked in the pigment ledger, the wander audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Full reward needs answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 37%. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
